content.json:
# Cosmos DB Logs

Cosmos DB diagnostics covering request unit consumption, throttled requests, query performance, partition hot-spotting, and availability.

content.query:
// Total RU consumption over time by database and collection
CDBDataPlaneRequests
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| summarize
    TotalRU = sum(RequestCharge),
    RequestCount = count()
    by bin(TimeGenerated, 15m), DatabaseName, CollectionName
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: RU Consumption Over Time

content.query:
// Top operations by RU cost
CDBDataPlaneRequests
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| summarize
    TotalRU = sum(RequestCharge),
    AvgRU = avg(RequestCharge),
    Count = count()
    by OperationName, DatabaseName, CollectionName
| top 20 by TotalRU desc
| project Database = DatabaseName, Collection = CollectionName, Operation = OperationName, TotalRU = round(TotalRU, 0), AvgRU = round(AvgRU, 1), Count
content.title: Top 20 Operations by Total RU Cost
Throttled Requests (429) Over Time

content.query:
// Throttled requests by partition key range — hot partition detection
CDBDataPlaneRequests
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| where StatusCode == 429
| summarize ThrottledCount = count(), AvgRU = avg(RequestCharge) by DatabaseName, CollectionName, PartitionId
| top 20 by ThrottledCount desc
| project Database = DatabaseName, Collection = CollectionName, Partition = PartitionId, ThrottledCount, AvgRU = round(AvgRU, 1)
content.title: Hot Partitions — Throttled by Partition ID

content.query:
// End-to-end latency percentiles (P50, P95, P99)
CDBDataPlaneRequests
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| where StatusCode >= 200 and StatusCode < 300
| summarize
    P50 = percentile(DurationMs, 50),
    P95 = percentile(DurationMs, 95),
    P99 = percentile(DurationMs, 99)
    by bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Request Latency Percentiles (ms)
Server Errors (5xx) Over Time

content.query:
// Cosmos DB query runtime statistics — expensive queries
CDBQueryRuntimeStatistics
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| summarize
    AvgRU = avg(RequestCharge),
    MaxRU = max(RequestCharge),
    AvgDurationMs = avg(DurationMs),
    Count = count()
    by QueryText = substring(QueryText, 0, 200), DatabaseName, CollectionName
| top 15 by AvgRU desc
| project Database = DatabaseName, Collection = CollectionName, QueryText, AvgRU = round(AvgRU, 1), MaxRU = round(MaxRU, 1), AvgDurationMs = round(AvgDurationMs, 1), Count
content.title: Most Expensive Queries by RU
